import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0].strip())
    s = data[1].strip()
    p = s.split("(")
    # Remove content inside parentheses and closing parenthesis from parts
    p = [part.split(")")[-1] for part in p]
    max_len = 0
    for part in p:
        tokens = part.split("_")
        for token in tokens:
            max_len = max(len(token), max_len)
    li = []
    last = -1
    for i, c in enumerate(s):
        if c == '(':
            last = i
        if c == ')' and last != -1:
            li.append(s[last+1:i])
    count = 0
    for segment in li:
        words = segment.split("_")
        for word in words:
            if len(word) > 0:
                count += 1
    print(f"{max_len} {count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
